title: Zombie Run and Lurch
summary: Hey Ohio, Cleveland History Days are here! Besides the dozens of other awesome events around the city, the Cemetery is hosting another FREE living history tour.  This year's theme centers around abolitionists of the 1800s who are resting in the cemetery. Tours stop off every fifteen minutes, with the last tour beginning at 3:00 p.m. Refreshments will be provided, and good for all ages. Donations are welcome, as always.

title: Zombie Run and Lurch
summary: Join us for an exciting run or walk along the Towpath Trail starting at Clark Field in Tremont. Dress up as a Zombie or put on your scariest outfit!
